This website uses cookies
To offer you an ever better browsing experience, this website uses its own cookies and those of selected third-party partners. Third-party cookies may also be profiling cookies. Please read our information on the use of cookies to find out more or go to "Customise" to manage your settings. By clicking "Accept" you consent to the storage of cookies on your device. By clicking "Reject", you accept the storage of only necessary cookies.

About

Cookies are small strings of text that sites visited by the user send to his/her terminal (usually to the browser), where they are stored so that they can be retransmitted to those sites on the user's next visit. When browsing a site, the user may also receive cookies on his/her terminal that are sent from different sites or web servers (so-called "third parties"), on which certain elements (such as, for example, images, maps, sounds, specific links to pages of other domains) on the site that he/she is visiting may reside. They can also collect information and data such as IP address, nationality, city, date/time, device, browser, operating system, screen resolution, browsing origin, pages visited and number of pages, visit duration, number of visits made, etc.

 

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third-party services that appear on our pages. To learn more about the use of Cookies click here

Why choose Actalis

Trusted by millions: Europe’s Leading Certification Authority

For over 20 years, Actalis has provided trusted services to tens of millions of users, earning recognition as Europe’s leading Certification Authority (Netcraft).

Discover why Actalis leads

Flexibility and customisation are at our core

Our products and services adapt to your business’s unique needs, offering tailored solutions for both public and private use.

ITIL-certified professionals supporting every step

From first contact to implementation and day-to-day operations, our ITIL-certified professionals ensure seamless process management and expert support at every stage.

eIDAS-qualified and CAB forum members

As the only Italian Certification Authority in the CAB Forum, we are eIDAS-qualified to deliver trusted digital services. Recognised as a Qualified Trust Service Provider, we provide QWAC and QSealC services in line with PSD2 regulations.

Trusted by industry leaders

Chosen for our expertise, professionalism and commitment to data security.

Actalis supports the Italian Central Public Administration and private companies of all sizes across industries, both nationally and internationally. A few of our trusted partners are shown below.

Experience, reliability and Rating 4 data centers

As part of the Aruba Group, Italy’s leading provider of domains, hosting, and certified email services, we offer unmatched reliability. Our Rating 4 data centers comply with ANSI/TIA 942 standards, ensuring top-tier resilience and infrastructure quality.

Find out more about our data centers

Certified – Accredited – Compliant

We are the only Italian Certification Authority in the CAB Forum and are recognised as a qualified trust service provider under EU eIDAS regulation. We’re also accredited as a PSD2 service provider.
